title: Reflexive Descent to Minimal Seeds in the Kreuzer-Skarke List: code, data and checks
description:
Code, data and checks for the paper Reflexive Descent to Minimal Seeds in the Kreuzer–Skarke List (revision of the preprint Hexagon 2610.00456v1).

The paper proves D_2 = 5, D_3 = 11, 22 ≤ D_4 ≤ 50 and H_4 ≤ 348 for the largest shortest and longest reflexive descents, and that depths add under free sums, so that D_d ≥ 11d/2 − 6 and D_d/d has a limit in [11/2, ∞]. The bound D_4 ≤ 50 rests on a chain of cuts for each of the 92,422,743 polytopes whose pair bound exceeds 50; every chain was replayed against all 473,800,776 polytopes of the Kreuzer–Skarke list (code/certify/results/r50/replay.json).

The exact value of D_4 is open. Code is MIT; the paper is CC BY 4.0; data derived from the Kreuzer–Skarke list keep its CC BY-SA 4.0 licence.
